title: Spooners
body:
# Spooners MC - Official Modpack
A lightweight but feature-rich modpack built for the **Spooners MC** server. It centers around **Create** and **Farmer’s Delight**, blending intricate automation with immersive cooking and farming.

This pack is perfect if you enjoy creative engineering, cozy farming, and a balanced survival challenge. It’s made for playing with friends — but is just as fun for solo play.

### Critical info:
- Designed for multiplayer on **Spooners MC**, but works fine in singleplayer.
- Focus is on **automation + farming**, with minimal performance overhead.
- Includes tweaks and optimizations to keep the experience **smooth and accessible**.

**_To play on the Spooners MC server, join our Discord at [discord.gg/9wA9u39](https://discord.gg/9wA9u39)
 and request to be whitelisted._**
